question: How is the descent of power and the samaya initiate identified in the Shripūrva teaching?
premises: The descent of power is distinguished as intense, mild, and so on.
This assessment is made from the trembling of the hand.
The Shripūrva declares such a person a samaya initiate.
inference: By observing degrees of hand-trembling, one discerns the kind of descent of power and identifies the person as a samaya initiate according to the Shripūrva.
uncertainties: karakampataḥ may refer to a specific textual source or to the sign of hand-trembling; the verse allows both readings.
plain_english: According to the Shripūrva, by the trembling of the hand and by differences such as intense or mild, one recognizes that kind of descent of power; such a person is declared a samaya initiate.
